# lost, both stacks in one session on one VM pair. The arms and the loads
#   dpdk-raw  every floor point of both sessions: the pong's first echo
#             waited for ARP in a loop of sends with no poll, so the answer
#             never came in and the send failed ("next hop unreachable (ARP
#             failed)"; floor.rs transport::pong now polls between retries)
#   -shared, -invoker  every point of both stacks: vm.sh refused the mixed
#             arms' 10 us conductor threshold against the conductor's own
#             idle strategy (backoff, 1 ms park), which SHARED and INVOKER
#             never run (vm.sh conductor_cycle_threshold_apply now reads the
#             agent that runs the conductor's cycle)
# mio-udp ran in both sessions: here it ties this VM pair to theirs. The
# floor's A/A repeats dpdk-raw; the mixed set's repeats aeron-mix-shared.
